name: Local Logic Escalator
purpose: Run an escalating ladder of local model tiers (tiny 0.5B -> weak 1.5B -> mid 3B -> strong 27B, all via model.gateway) over a batch of tasks. The weakest tier answers; each higher tier judges the current answer and either accepts it (stop -- the accepted layer is the tier that produced the current answer) or produces its own answer for the next tier to judge; the top tier's answer is accepted if reached. Every rung is anchored with DETERMINISTIC ground-truth gates (in-set membership for classify; JSON-schema validity + source grounding for extract; self-consistency across samples) so the ladder never rests on LLM-judges-LLM alone: a hard-fail overrides an LLM-judge ACCEPT (anti-rubber-stamp) and strong self-consistency accepts without a judge (cost saver). Generalizes review.processor (#9) + route.tasks (#24); the cost-offload keystone -- every task a low tier finishes end-to-end is one the frontier allotment never pays for. Orchestrator, NOT a review-queue producer: suppresses the child gateway's review writes and surfaces needs_frontier per task in its own result.

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Kind <classify|extract|generic>; -Tasks <array> | -TasksPath <file>; -Labels <array> (classify) / -Fields <array> (extract); -Tiers <ordered alias array, default [tiny,weak,mid,strong]>; -Samples <K self-consistency, default 1>; -SampleTemperature <default 0.7>; -AcceptConsistency <short-circuit agreement, default 1.0>; -FrontierThreshold <default 0.5>; sampling -MaxTokens -Temperature -Seed -MaxInputChars; -LoadTimeoutSec (raise for a cold strong tier); -GpuLayers; plumbing -Registry -GatewayPath -PwshPath -ReviewQueuePath (relocates the suppressed gateway-review sink; this skill never writes the canonical queue). OR -InputsJson '<json {kind,tasks,tasks_path,labels,fields,tiers,samples,sample_temperature,accept_consistency,frontier_threshold,max_tokens,temperature,seed,max_input_chars,load_timeout_s,gpu_layers,registry,gateway_path,pwsh_path,review_queue_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.description: Task kind + its deterministic gate: classify (closed-set label; in-set gate) | extract (named fields; JSON-schema + source-grounding gate) | generic (freeform; ungated, self-consistency only).

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.description: Batch of tasks. classify {id?,text,labels?}; extract {id?,text,fields?}; generic {id?,prompt}.

inputs.name: tasks_path
inputs.description: A JSON file: an array of tasks, or an object {kind?,labels?,fields?,tasks:[...]}.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Shared closed label set for classify (a per-task `labels` overrides).

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: Shared field names for extract (a per-task `fields` overrides).

inputs.name: tiers
inputs.description: Ordered ladder of model.gateway tier aliases (tiny=0.5B, weak=1.5B, mid=3B, strong=27B).

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: Self-consistency samples per answer step (K). K>1 samples at sample_temperature and majority-votes; agreement >= accept_consistency + a hard-pass short-circuits (accept with no judge call). K=1 is a single greedy answer (no self-consistency signal).

inputs.name: sample_temperature
inputs.description: Temperature for the K>1 self-consistency samples.

inputs.name: accept_consistency
inputs.description: Self-consistency agreement (0..1) at which a hard-passing answer short-circuits-accepts without a judge call.

inputs.name: frontier_threshold
inputs.description: Per-task confidence below this (or a hard-fail) sets needs_frontier=true (a status signal; NOT a review-queue write).

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Override the per-call generation cap (default: kind-specific answer/judge caps).

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.description: Greedy temperature for K=1 answers and for judge calls.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Base RNG seed passed to the gateway (K>1 uses seed, seed+1, ...).

inputs.name: max_input_chars
inputs.description: Cap on the task text shown to the model.

inputs.name: load_timeout_s
inputs.description: Override the gateway server load timeout; raise for a COLD strong (27B) load (~90s).

inputs.name: gpu_layers
inputs.description: Override the gateway gpu_layers (e.g. to tune the 27B partial offload).

inputs.name: registry
inputs.description: Path to the gateway's models.json (passed through).

inputs.name: gateway_path
inputs.description: Path to Invoke-ModelGateway.ps1 (default: resolved from modules/07-model-gateway).

inputs.name: pwsh_path
inputs.description: pwsh executable used to spawn the gateway child (default the dotnet-tool pwsh).

inputs.name: review_queue_path
inputs.description: Relocates the in-artifact sink for the SUPPRESSED child-gateway review writes. This skill is not a review-queue producer and never writes the canonical review_queue.jsonl.

outputs.description: { kind, tiers, samples, accept_consistency, frontier_threshold, count, resolved_count, needs_frontier_count, error_count, resolve_distribution:{<tier>:n}, cost:{total_gateway_calls, total_prompt_tokens, total_completion_tokens, total_tokens, mean_calls_per_task, total_runtime_ms}, tasks:[ {id, kind, status, accepted_tier, accepted_tier_index, answer, confidence, needs_frontier, accepted_via, self_consistency, gate:{hard_pass,grounded,reason}, ladder:[ {tier, tier_index, role:answer|judge, ok, samples?, agreement?, accept?, judge_confidence?, produced_answer?, hardpass?, finish_reason, error} ], gateway_calls} ], labels?|fields?, is_review_producer:false, gateway_reviews_suppressed_to }

models: the four wired GGUF LLM tiers via model.gateway (tiny=0.5B, weak=1.5B, mid=3B, strong=27B)
